injuries.description: the plaintiff's right forearm suffered a deep transverse cut.
source: the plaintiff's right forearm suffered a deep transverse cut.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of forearm

injuries.description: Some of the muscles and tendons to the plaintiff's right hand were cut through.
source: Some of the muscles and tendons to the plaintiff's right hand were cut through.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia or tendon at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: the flexor pollicis longus ... had also been cut through in the accident
source: the flexor pollicis longus and the radial nerve of the plaintiff's right hand had also been cut through in the accident
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

injuries.description: the radial nerve of the plaintiff's right hand had also been cut through in the accident
injuries.body_part: radial nerve of right forearm / right hand
source: the flexor pollicis longus and the radial nerve of the plaintiff's right hand had also been cut through in the accident
injuries.icd_description: Injury of radial nerve at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: stiffness and weakness of the thumb
an inability to grip objects properly
wasting of the muscles of the right thumb had become more obvious
no longer able to have sufficient manipulation of his right hand to perform a decoration Sifu's work
he is not able to hold a decorator's tools in his right hand with any control or dexterity.

treatments_received: An operation at Caritas Medical Centre was performed to "repair the divided structures", that is, the severed nerves and tendons were sewn back together again.

losses.description: Reduced function of right hand and thumb (stiffness, weakness, numbness and muscle wasting) affecting grip and manipulation.
Unable to continue work as a decoration Sifu and forced to take up work as a hawker.
